title: The Forever Home #3
desc: Welcome to the end of the world. Make yourself at home, won't you? Visionary creators Christian Ward (Batman: City of Madness) and Sami Kivelä (Abbott) are about to reach the apex of their mind-bending science-fiction masterpiece . . . and you won't want to miss a moment of the year's most unpredictable new series. A stranger approaches, desperately hungry and alone, and immediately alters the trajectory of the Forever Home and its inhabitants. That is, until young Tommy accidentally escapes . . . and returns a man with a new family and a new mission to fight his father for control of the one time-lost oasis beyond the reach of Earth's apocalypse.
